title: omphalodes nitida
intro: Omphalodes nitida, commonly known as Water Violet or Kidney Clover, is a perennial plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Omphalodes nitida may include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
